newsitem.title: DUBAI: Businessmen to invest in any Saudi airline selloff.
newsitem.headline: Businessmen to invest in any Saudi airline selloff.

text.p: Saudi businessmen are prepared to invest in any full or partial privatisation of flag carrier Saudi Arabian Airlines Corp, the English-language Arab News daily reported on Wednesday.
"We are ready to participate and invest in all or any part of Saudi Arabian Airlines," it quoted Abdul Rahman al-Jeraisy, chairman of the Riyadh Chamber of Commerce, as saying.
"We, as businessmen, are ready to respond favourably in case a decision is taken in this respect, and are ready to cooperate if there is any privatisation," Jeraisy said.
He was speaking at a meeting of Saudi businessmen with Saudi Arabian Airlines Director General Khaled Ben-Bakr.

The paper said the meeting, in the Red Sea city of Jeddah, was aimed at briefing Saudi businessmen on the returns on any investment in the catering and cargo divisions of the airline, in the event of privatisation.
Saudi Arabia has said that a larger private sector role is one of the transport sector's top priorities in the state's five-year plan to 2000.
